text:
Review complete — I read every source file, the tests, the config, and the committed output artifacts. Here's the honest assessment.

## Bottom line first

**No, I would not approve this as-is.** The per-line code quality is actually decent — clean, typed, modular, sensibly factored. But the repo has two structural problems that outweigh the polish:

1. **It does not run.** Every extraction path reads stories from `data/stories/` (`emovec/config.py:39`, `emovec/data.py:24-36`), and that directory was never committed — the repo contains no `data/` at all. So `make demo`, all three CLI commands, and the integration test (`tests/test_integration_tiny.py`) fail immediately with `FileNotFoundError`. The committed `outputs/tiny_demo/` artifacts were generated from a dataset that only existed on the contractor's machine (the output manifest references 20 topics × 16 emotions × 4 stories of source data) and cannot be regenerated. The README's claim that "the full pipeline can run on CPU" is currently false.

2. **The demo validation is rigged.** In tiny mode, `extract.py:32` passes each story's ground-truth emotion label into the backend, which injects 2.0× the true emotion vector into the activations (`model.py:147-148`). On top of that, the tiny backend's `EMOTION_LEXICON` (`model.py:15-32`) contains words copied verbatim from the validation scenarios in `data.py:63-80` — "rocket", "choir", "memorial", "snapping", "trail", "fifth". So the integration test's assertion that `diagonal_gt_off_diagonal is True` is true by construction, not because the pipeline works. The test suite is largely validating a tautology.

## Quality score: 5/10

Good bones (clean separation of extract/validate/steer, deterministic seeding, manifests recording provenance, `yaml.safe_load`, no real security exposure), dragged down hard by being non-runnable as shipped and self-confirming in test mode.

## Concrete issues

| # | File | Lines | Sev | Description |
|---|------|-------|-----|-------------|
| 1 | emovec/data.py | 24-45 | high | Reads stories from `data/stories/` which is absent from the repo — extract, `make demo`, and the integration test all crash; committed outputs are unreproducible |
| 2 | emovec/extract.py | 32 | high | Ground-truth emotion label leaked to the tiny backend as `label_hint`, making tiny-mode extraction/validation circular |
| 3 | emovec/model.py | 15-32 | medium | `EMOTION_LEXICON` contains words copied from the validation `SCENARIOS`, hard-coding validation success in tiny mode |
| 4 | tests/test_integration_tiny.py | 12-26 | medium | End-to-end test fails as shipped (missing data) and depends on cwd-relative `config.yaml`; asserts an outcome that's guaranteed by construction |
| 5 | emovec/model.py | 234-240 | medium | `prompt.find(activity_name)` returning -1 is unhandled — steering silently applies to (nearly) all token positions instead of erroring |
| 6 | emovec/validate_contexts.py | 66 | medium | If "afraid" isn't in the emotion list, silently substitutes emotion index 0 but still writes files labeled `afraid_dosage` |
| 7 | emovec/validate_contexts.py / steer_prefs.py | 24 / 30 | medium | No check that the runtime backend matches the manifest's backend/d_model — mixing `--tiny` with HF-extracted vectors crashes or yields silent nonsense |
| 8 | emovec/elo.py | 17-19 | medium | Magic temperature `/20.0` tuned to the tiny backend's utility scale; with real HF logit differences (~1-5), pairwise probabilities sit near 0.5 and Elo shifts are negligible |
| 9 | emovec/extract.py | 34-36 | low | Duplicates the start-position logic inside `layer_position_mean` (line 19); the two copies can drift |
| 10 | emovec/config.py | 42-54 | low | No config validation — a missing `scale`/`tiny` section yields empty emotions and a cryptic `np.stack` crash instead of a clear error |
| 11 | config.yaml | 10, 50 | low | `neutral_corpus` and `min_reported_emotions` are read by no code — dead config keys |
| 12 | emovec/model.py | 7 | low | Unused import `Iterable` |
| 13 | emovec/model.py | 306-308 | low | Uses only the first token of `" good"`/`" bad"` encodings without checking they're single tokens — silently wrong on some tokenizers |
| 14 | outputs/ | — | low | ~17 generated artifacts (.npy/.png/.csv) committed to the repo; no .gitignore |

## Rewrite estimate

The codebase is ~1,100 lines of Python. The fixes cluster around: a story-generation or data-committing path (~80-100 new/changed lines in `data.py`/`extract.py`), de-rigging the tiny backend so tests validate the pipeline rather than the answer key (~60 lines in `model.py`/`extract.py`/tests), backend-mismatch guards and config validation (~30 lines), and the small items (~20 lines). Call it **~180 lines**, roughly 16% of the codebase — plus the non-code work of recovering or regenerating the missing story dataset, which is the real blocker.

One caveat in fairness to the contractor: the rigged tiny backend may have been an intentional "deterministic fixture" design choice rather than deception — but even granting that, shipping it as the only thing the test suite exercises, alongside an uncommitted dataset, leaves you with no actual evidence the HF path works.
